title: Topology
name: Name
schematicExplanation: This diagram element explains missing evidence. It is not discovered hardware and cannot run diagnostics.
diagnosticsUnavailable: Diagnostics are unavailable for this site or your current permissions.
search: Search this site by name or address
selectionRemoved: The selected item is no longer available.
layoutConflict: The shared layout changed. Your preview is preserved. Reload the latest layout before making a new edit.
reloadLayout: Discard preview and reload shared layout
layout_fallback: Automatic arrangement reached its limit. Remaining nodes use a local grid; saved positions are retained.
pinned_overlap: Saved devices overlap. Unpin them and reflow to separate their labels.
empty: No topology is available yet. Add an agent, discovery profile, or manual network for this site.
legend: Solid: physical · Dashed: logical · Dotted: inferred or schematic. Unknown health is not a successful check.
diagnosticScope: Choose a same-site origin and address family. Only Run diagnostic sends a command; each family has its own bounded run.
noAgent: No eligible same-site agent is available.
targetNotConfigured: Target not configured. Configure an explicit target before running this check.
previewExpired: This preview expired. Generate a new preview to continue.
recurringUnavailable: Recurring monitoring is not available in this release. Saved drafts will not run.
outboundEnabled: Allow checks against explicitly configured outbound targets
noDefaultTargets: Targets start empty. Saving a target does not run it or enable recurring monitoring.
configurationConflict: Configuration changed elsewhere. Your draft is preserved; compare it with the current revision before trying again.
chooseSiteExplanation: Select one authorized site to keep its network and diagnostics separate.
reloadConfiguration: Discard draft and reload current configuration
applyToSites: Apply selected versions to authorized sites

off.title: Network Topology is off
off.body: Breeze can build a live map of this site's network from agent and SNMP data.
off.partnerNextStep: A partner admin can turn it on in Settings → Modules.
off.orgNextStep: Ask your MSP to enable it.

preparing.title: Building the topology map
preparing.body: Breeze is collecting network data for this site. This usually completes within a few minutes of enabling the feature.

unavailable.title: Topology unavailable
unavailable.body: The topology view cannot be shown for this site right now. Try again later or contact support if it persists.

details.expired: Observation detail has expired; the connection was still confirmed.
details.unavailable: No observation detail is available for this connection.

physicalView.empty: No physical connections have been reported for this site yet.

reasons.topology_preparing: No topology snapshot has been published yet.
reasons.legacy_evidence_only: Inventory and legacy data only; discovery coverage and health are not established.
reasons.projection_bounded: Some devices or connections are outside this view.
reasons.physical_disabled: Physical topology is turned off for this organization.
reasons.no_collector: No collector reports physical connections for this site.
reasons.collection_pending: A physical collection is still running.
reasons.collection_not_received: An authorized collection did not report before its deadline.
reasons.collection_complete_empty: A collection completed but found no neighbors. This does not mean the whole site is covered.
reasons.collection_unsupported: A device does not support a requested protocol.
reasons.collection_partial_limit: A collection hit its row limit; some rows were left out.
reasons.collection_partial: A collection returned only part of its tables.
reasons.collection_not_attempted: A requested scope was not attempted.
reasons.collection_stale: Physical evidence has not been confirmed recently.
reasons.credentials_missing: No usable SNMP credentials are configured for a device.
reasons.credentials_rejected: A device rejected the configured SNMP credentials.
reasons.interface_unresolved: Some connections were reported on ports that could not be identified.
reasons.controller_site_unmapped: A UniFi controller site is not mapped to a Breeze site.
reasons.controller_site_other_org: A UniFi controller site is mapped to another organization.

stepUp.heading: Confirm it's you
stepUp.intro: Turning on recurring measurement needs a fresh second-factor check for this exact change.
stepUp.passkey: You will confirm with your passkey.
stepUp.noFactor: Add an authenticator app or passkey to your account before turning on recurring measurement.

history.heading: History of {{port}}
history.generationBreak: This port changed identity {{count}} times in this range. Each generation is shown separately and is never joined.

link.heading: Link health
link.notApplicable: Port measurement does not describe this connection

policy.heading: Recurring monitoring
policy.none: No monitoring policy covers this site yet.
policy.noneForSubject: No monitoring policy targets this item.
policy.conflict: This policy changed since you opened it. Reload and review it again.
policy.subject: Subject

origins.eligible_collector: An eligible collector in this site

policy.contexts: Up to two routing contexts are selected when you enable it; more needs an explicit choice.
policy.thresholds: Alert after {{failure}} failures, clear after {{recovery}} successes
policy.alertsOff: Alerts are off for this policy
policy.volume: About {{runs}} checks per day per context
policy.reuse: An equivalent existing monitor can be bound after enabling; it is reused rather than probed twice.
policy.readOnly: You can view monitoring but not change it.
policy.intentRequired: Turn this policy on in the site configuration before enabling monitoring.

telemetry.heading: Port measurement
telemetry.intro: Poll selected ports of this device over SNMP. Nothing is measured until you turn it on.
telemetry.noPorts: Port not identified: no canonical ports of this device are known yet.
telemetry.noCollector: No agent in this site can poll this device.
telemetry.noCredential: No enabled discovery profile in this site has SNMP credentials.
telemetry.enableFailed: Could not turn on port measurement
telemetry.revokeFailed: Could not turn off port measurement
telemetry.unavailable: Port measurement is not available for this site.

trace.heading: Observed routed path
trace.explanation: An observed routed path from one origin at one moment. It is not a topology connection.
trace.routeChanged: The route changed during the trace

impact.heading: Possible impact
impact.noMeasured: No fresh measured failure in the last {{minutes}} min.
impact.hypothetical: Nothing is measured as failing here; this is a what-if analysis.
impact.noPotential: Nothing is known to depend on this.

basis.dependency_path: Depends on it through a known connection
basis.group_membership: Member of an affected group (possible only)

pathReason.alternative_path_unverified: Another path exists; whether it carries traffic is not verified
pathReason.group_member_possible: Group membership does not prove a cable dependency

impact.routed: Observed routed path: {{responding}} responding hops, {{gaps}} silent hops

cause.possible: Possible cause, corroborated by {{count}} measured failures

impact.omittedCount: {{count}} more possibly affected items not shown
impact.changed: The map changed since this view loaded. Refresh to analyze the current map.
impact.noAlerts: This is an explanation only. It never changes, silences or closes an alert.
